title: 第5章 黑风山脉凡剑第6章 历练杀戮
slug: 无敌凡体以剑证道杀穿三千界
lines: 自始至终，陈红海都显得很是平静，云淡风轻。
他用俯瞰的眼神看向李轩，淡声道：
“年轻人，修炼不易，何必要自己找死呢？”
“老夫不想对你这种蝼蚁动手，如果你愿意自己跪下来，任由老夫废掉修为，老夫可让你免皮肉之苦。”
李轩对于这种倚老卖老的脑残，那是只有两个字：“傻比。”
陈红海大怒，这小杂毛简直放肆！
轰地一声。
炼气境七重的气息陡然爆发开来，他作势就要动手。
然而，李轩的动作却是比他更快。
炼气境四重的气息爆发开来。
嗖！
只是一个闪烁，便是已经逼近陈红海。
陈红海大惊！
李轩的速度怎么会这么快？
他没来得及动手，更是没来得及做出任何反应，李轩的右手就已经成拳，一拳砸向了他脑袋。
嘭！
一声闷响。
陈红海头颅炸裂，红白之物喷射开来，血溅当场。
葬神鼎内散发出一道幽芒，瞬间将陈红海尸体卷走，李轩则是已经转身一脚踢在了赵常龙身上。
嘭！
赵常龙直接飞出去，剧烈的疼痛让他忍不住发出了杀猪般的惨叫。
回过神后，赵常龙简直都有些懵，难以置信，“不，这不可能，这怎么可能啊？”
他是真的难以相信，也难以接受，强大的炼气境七重陈红海，竟然就这样被秒了。
搞啥呢？
其余那些赵家人回过神来，也都是一脸的震惊，紧接着便是惊悚。
那可是陈红海，炼气境七重的陈红海啊，这些年来，他杀了多少高手，灭了多少家族啊？
然而，现在却是被秒了。
什么鬼？
“要我跪下忏悔，还要撕烂我的嘴，你算什么东西，你赵家又算什么东西，你们配吗？”
李轩居高临下看着赵常龙，一副不屑的神情。
他虽然只有炼气境四重，但毕竟是曾经的帝族少主，又岂是那陈红海可比？
若是对付那些妖孽炼气境七重，李轩或许会有压力，但这陈红海，轻松拿捏。
content_en:
From beginning to end, Chen Honghai looked very calm and calm.
He looked at Li Xuan with a bird's eye view and said softly:
"Young man, cultivation is not easy, why should you seek death yourself?"
"I don't want to do anything to an ant like you. If you are willing to kneel down and let me destroy your cultivation, I can spare you the pain of your skin and flesh."
Li Xuan only has two words for this kind of idiot who relies on his elders and sells his elders: "Silly."
Chen Honghai was furious, this little bastard was so wanton!
There was a bang.
The aura of the seventh level of Qi Refining Realm suddenly burst out, and he was about to take action.
However, Li Xuan's movements were faster than him.
The breath of the fourth level of Qi Refining Realm exploded.
Whoosh!
Just a flicker, and it was already approaching Chen Honghai.
Chen Honghai was shocked!
How could Li Xuan be so fast?
Before he could make a move, or even react, Li Xuan's right hand turned into a fist and hit him on the head.
Bang!
There was a muffled sound.
Chen Honghai's head exploded, red and white things sprayed out, and blood spattered on the spot.
A faint light emitted from the God Burial Cauldron, instantly sweeping away Chen Honghai's body. Li Xuan had already turned around and kicked Zhao Changlong.
Bang!
Zhao Changlong flew out directly, and the severe pain made him scream like a pig.
After coming back to his senses, Zhao Changlong was a little confused and couldn't believe it, "No, this is impossible, how is this possible?"
It was really hard for him to believe and accept that Chen Honghai, a powerful seventh-level Qi Refining Realm, was killed like this.
What are you doing?
When the rest of the Zhao family came back to their senses, they all looked shocked, followed by horror.
That was Chen Honghai, Chen Honghai, who was at the seventh level of the Qi Refining Realm. Over the years, how many masters had he killed and how many families had he destroyed?
However, now it was stopped.
What the hell?
"If you ask me to kneel down and repent, and tear my mouth apart, who do you think you are, and who do you think the Zhao family is? Do you deserve it?"
Li Xuan looked down at Zhao Changlong with a look of disdain.
Although he is only at the fourth level of Qi Refining Realm, he is still the former young master of the Imperial Clan. How can he be compared to Chen Honghai?
If he had to deal with those monsters at the seventh level of the Qi Refining Realm, Li Xuan might be under pressure, but Chen Honghai could handle it easily.
